summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized a Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 2,426,872 subordinate voting shares, representing ~16.75% of outstanding shares as of August 13, 2026. Purchases occur on the Canadian Securities Exchange at prevailing market prices via broker Haywood Securities Inc. under an automatic repurchase plan. The bid runs from August 17, 2026 to August 17, 2027; shares bought are cancelled. No price per share or premium specified. Watch for actual repurchase pace and market liquidity, as NCIB is optional and can be suspended.
